description: Hill Monitor answers questions about Canadian Parliament. It searches House and Senate transcripts, Question Period, committee schedules, the Canada Gazette, government news, press conferences, bills, the Order Paper, Orders in Council, MP and senator posts, and ministerial office staff. Signed-in users can list their phrase alerts, see recent hits, and create a new alert.

defaultPrompt: Summarize the House Agriculture committee meeting today.
What has the Prime Minister said in Parliament this week?
What House and Senate committees are meeting today?
